answer: Witnessed physical-site registration. Each identity must be enrolled at a registered site whose coordinates sit on a unique knoll with clear sky view, where an installer records a signed, time-stamped RF fingerprint of the antenna's local multipath. Enrollment issues one lotus credential bound to that fingerprint. A roaming zephyr audit unit later re-measures the fingerprint on random visits; mismatch revokes the credential. Faking one identity requires physically building and maintaining a distinct antenna site, costing hardware, land access, and audit exposure per Sybil.
